requirements.title: Git Remote and URL Parsing
requirements.rationale: Detecting repository references and web URLs simplifies command-line invocations across diverse git configurations.

criteria.condition: ParseRepo is called with a path string containing one or more slash delimiters and non-empty segments
criteria.action: parse the string into a Repo whose Name is the last path segment and Owner is all preceding segments joined by slash, returning the Repo and true
criteria.contract: the last path segment is assigned to Name; all preceding path segments joined by slash are assigned to Owner; the returned boolean is true

setup: repository path strings representing standard and nested group structures
check.pseudocode:
r1, ok1 := ParseRepo("octocat/Hello-World")
assert ok1 == true
assert r1.Owner == "octocat" && r1.Name == "Hello-World"

r2, ok2 := ParseRepo("gitlab-org/subgroup/project")
assert ok2 == true
assert r2.Owner == "gitlab-org/subgroup" && r2.Name == "project"

criteria.condition: ParseRepo is called with an empty string or a string without slash delimiters
criteria.action: reject the input and return a zero-value Repo with false
criteria.contract: (Repo{}, false)

setup: empty or slash-less input strings

criteria.condition: ParseRemote is called with an HTTPS, SSH, or SCP-style git remote URL matching a supported forge host
criteria.action: parse the remote URL into a Repo containing Host, Owner with multi-segment support, and Name without .git suffix, returning the Repo and true
criteria.contract: ParseRemote returns true and populates Host, Owner (including nested groups), and Name without .git suffix

setup: various valid remote URL strings across HTTPS, SSH, and SCP-style syntax for GitHub and GitLab
check.pseudocode:
r1, ok1 := ParseRemote("https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git")
assert ok1 == true && r1.Host == "github.com" && r1.Owner == "octocat" && r1.Name == "Hello-World"

r2, ok2 := ParseRemote("git@gitlab.com:group/subgroup/repo.git")
assert ok2 == true && r2.Host == "gitlab.com" && r2.Owner == "group/subgroup" && r2.Name == "repo"

r3, ok3 := ParseRemote("ssh://git@github.com/org/repo.git")
assert ok3 == true && r3.Host == "github.com" && r3.Owner == "org" && r3.Name == "repo"

criteria.condition: ParseRemote is called with an invalid remote URL, missing host, or unsupported format
criteria.action: reject the remote URL and return a zero-value Repo with false
criteria.contract: (Repo{}, false)

setup: invalid, empty, or unsupported remote URL strings

criteria.condition: DetectRepo is called with a directory path whose git origin remote is configured and readable
criteria.action: execute git remote get-url origin in the target directory, pass the output to ParseRemote, and return the resulting Repo with true
criteria.contract: for a valid git repo with origin, DetectRepo returns the parsed Repo and true; for an invalid or remote-less directory, DetectRepo returns a zero-value Repo and false without error

setup: a temporary git repository directory with an origin remote and a non-git directory

criteria.condition: DetectRepo is called on a directory that is not a git repository or has no origin remote configured
criteria.action: return a zero-value Repo with false without returning an error
criteria.contract: (Repo{}, false)

criteria.condition: ParseIssueURL is called with a valid GitHub or GitLab web issue or pull request URL
criteria.action: parse the URL into an IssueRef with Repo, Number, and IsPullRequest set to true for PR and MR URLs, returning the IssueRef and true
criteria.contract: ParseIssueURL returns true and sets Repo, Number, and IsPullRequest accurately for issues and PRs/MRs

setup: valid GitHub and GitLab web issue and pull/merge request URLs
check.pseudocode:
ref1, ok1 := ParseIssueURL("https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123")
assert ok1 == true && ref1.Repo.Owner == "owner" && ref1.Number == 123 && ref1.IsPullRequest == false

ref2, ok2 := ParseIssueURL("https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/456")
assert ok2 == true && ref2.Repo.Owner == "owner" && ref2.Number == 456 && ref2.IsPullRequest == true

ref3, ok3 := ParseIssueURL("https://gitlab.com/group/sub/proj/-/issues/789")
assert ok3 == true && ref3.Repo.Owner == "group/sub" && ref3.Number == 789 && ref3.IsPullRequest == false

ref4, ok4 := ParseIssueURL("https://gitlab.com/group/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/101")
assert ok4 == true && ref4.Repo.Owner == "group/sub" && ref4.Number == 101 && ref4.IsPullRequest == true

criteria.condition: ParseIssueURL is called with an invalid URL, a non-issue path, or a non-numeric identifier
criteria.action: reject the URL and return a zero-value IssueRef with false
criteria.contract: (IssueRef{}, false)

setup: malformed, non-numeric, or non-issue web URLs

requirements.title: Forge Detection and Options Configuration
requirements.rationale: Automatic forge detection selects the target platform from configuration, environment variables, or local git remotes.

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with Options having NoOp set to true
criteria.action: instantiate and return a NoOpClient instance and nil error
criteria.contract: NewWithOptions returns a non-nil client and a nil error; the client is an instance of NoOpClient

setup: Options with NoOp set to true
check.pseudocode:
client, err := NewWithOptions(Options{NoOp: true})
assert err == nil
assert client != nil
assert client.Authenticated() == false

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with BaseURL containing github or api.github.com
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitHub
criteria.contract: GitHub URL resolves to ForgeTypeGitHub; GitLab URL resolves to ForgeTypeGitLab

setup: Options with explicit BaseURL targeting GitHub and GitLab hosts
check.pseudocode:
// Pre-adapter phase: detection succeeds, then unsupported forge error is returned indicating missing adapter
_, err1 := NewWithOptions(Options{BaseURL: "https://api.github.com"})
assert errors.Is(err1, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err1.Error(), "github")

_, err2 := NewWithOptions(Options{BaseURL: "https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4"})
assert errors.Is(err2, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err2.Error(), "gitlab")

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with BaseURL containing gitlab
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitLab

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with empty BaseURL and GitHub environment variables are present while GitLab environment variables are absent
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitHub with default endpoint https://api.github.com and credentials from GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN
criteria.contract: presence of GitHub tokens resolves to GitHub forge with default endpoint https://api.github.com; presence of GitLab tokens resolves to GitLab forge with default endpoint https://gitlab.com/api/v4

setup: environment variables set for GitHub only, and alternatively GitLab only
check.pseudocode:
// GitHub only:
t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "gh-tok")
t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")
_, err1 := NewWithOptions(Options{})
assert errors.Is(err1, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err1.Error(), "github")

// GitLab only:
t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "gl-tok")
_, err2 := NewWithOptions(Options{})
assert errors.Is(err2, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err2.Error(), "gitlab")

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with empty BaseURL and GitLab environment variables are present while GitHub environment variables are absent
criteria.action: resolve the forge type to ForgeTypeGitLab with default endpoint https://gitlab.com/api/v4 and credentials from GITLAB_TOKEN

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions is called with empty BaseURL and forge environment variables are either both present or both absent and the git origin remote in the working directory matches a recognized forge host
criteria.action: resolve the forge type corresponding to the git origin remote host
criteria.contract: the forge type resolves according to the host of the git origin remote

setup: a directory whose git origin remote points to a recognized forge and empty environment variables
check.pseudocode:
dir := setupTempGitRepoWithOrigin("git@gitlab.com:team/project.git")
origDir, _ := os.Getwd()
os.Chdir(dir)
defer os.Chdir(origDir)

t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")
_, err := NewWithOptions(Options{})
assert errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "gitlab")

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions cannot determine the forge type from BaseURL, environment variables, or git origin remote
criteria.action: reject client construction and return a nil Client and an error wrapping ErrAmbiguousForge
criteria.contract: (nil, err) where errors.Is(err, ErrAmbiguousForge) is true

setup: no BaseURL, no forge environment variables, and no git origin remote in current directory
check.pseudocode:
nonGitDir := t.TempDir()
origDir, _ := os.Getwd()
os.Chdir(nonGitDir)
defer os.Chdir(origDir)

t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")
client, err := NewWithOptions(Options{})
assert client == nil
assert errors.Is(err, ErrAmbiguousForge) == true

criteria.condition: NewWithOptions resolves a forge type to ForgeTypeGitHub or ForgeTypeGitLab prior to provider adapter registration
criteria.action: reject client construction and return a nil Client and an error wrapping ErrUnsupportedForge indicating the provider adapter is not registered
criteria.contract: (nil, err) where errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedForge) is true

setup: a detected forge type prior to provider adapter registration in issuex_core
check.pseudocode:
client, err := NewWithOptions(Options{BaseURL: "https://api.github.com", Token: "fake"})
assert client == nil
assert errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupportedForge) == true

requirements.title: Standardized Error Types and Classification
requirements.rationale: Standardized error types allow consumers to distinguish and handle distinct forge failure modes cleanly.

criteria.action: define sentinel errors ErrNoToken, ErrNotFound, ErrConflict, ErrRateLimited, ErrUnsupportedForge, and ErrAmbiguousForge
criteria.contract: all six sentinel errors are non-nil distinct errors; HTTPError formats Error() as fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %d %s", e.Method, e.Path, e.Status, e.Message)

setup: sentinel error definitions and an HTTPError instance
check.pseudocode:
assert ErrNoToken != nil
assert ErrNotFound != nil
assert ErrConflict != nil
assert ErrRateLimited != nil
assert ErrUnsupportedForge != nil
assert ErrAmbiguousForge != nil

httpErr := &HTTPError{Method: "GET", Path: "/repos", Status: 404, Message: "Not Found"}
assert httpErr.Error() == "GET /repos: 404 Not Found"

criteria.action: define HTTPError carrying Method, Path, Status, Message, RetryAfterHeader, RateLimitReset, and RateLimitRemaining, formatted by Error() as fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %d %s", e.Method, e.Path, e.Status, e.Message)

criteria.condition: RetryAfter is called on an HTTPError with status 429 or status 403 with RateLimitRemaining 0 and a valid Retry-After or X-RateLimit-Reset header
criteria.action: calculate the backoff duration from the header value plus a 1-second buffer and return the duration with true
criteria.contract: RetryAfter returns header backoff duration plus 1-second buffer with true for 429 and 403 quota exhaustion; for non-rate-limit errors or missing headers, RetryAfter returns 0 and false

setup: various HTTPError instances representing rate-limiting and non-rate-limiting responses

criteria.condition: RetryAfter is called on an HTTPError with non-rate-limit status or missing rate-limit headers
criteria.action: return zero duration and false
criteria.contract: (0, false)

criteria.condition: IsNotFound is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrNotFound or is an HTTPError with status 404, and false otherwise
criteria.contract: IsNotFound returns true for ErrNotFound or HTTP 404; IsConflict returns true for ErrConflict or HTTP 409; IsRateLimited returns true for ErrRateLimited, HTTP 429, or HTTP 403 with remaining 0; IsNoToken returns true for ErrNoToken

setup: various wrapped errors and HTTPError instances
check.pseudocode:
assert IsNotFound(ErrNotFound) == true
assert IsNotFound(&HTTPError{Status: 404}) == true
assert IsNotFound(errors.New("other")) == false

assert IsConflict(ErrConflict) == true
assert IsConflict(&HTTPError{Status: 409}) == true

assert IsRateLimited(ErrRateLimited) == true
assert IsRateLimited(&HTTPError{Status: 429}) == true
assert IsRateLimited(&HTTPError{Status: 403, RateLimitRemaining: "0"}) == true

assert IsNoToken(ErrNoToken) == true
assert IsNoToken(errors.New("other")) == false

criteria.condition: IsConflict is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrConflict or is an HTTPError with status 409, and false otherwise

criteria.condition: IsRateLimited is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrRateLimited or is an HTTPError with status 429 or status 403 with RateLimitRemaining 0, and false otherwise

criteria.condition: IsNoToken is called with an error
criteria.action: return true if the error wraps ErrNoToken, and false otherwise

requirements.title: Shared Transport Foundation
requirements.rationale: Centralized transport safety prevents out-of-memory errors on large payloads and manages rate-limit backoff consistently.

criteria.action: bound HTTP response body reads using io.LimitReader to a maximum of 8 MB (8388608 bytes)
criteria.contract: response body reads are capped at 8388608 bytes (8 MB)

setup: an HTTP response stream exceeding 8 MB in size
check.pseudocode:
largeBody := make([]byte, 10<<20) // 10 MB
r := io.LimitReader(bytes.NewReader(largeBody), 8<<20)
readBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r)
assert err == nil
assert len(readBytes) == 8388608

criteria.condition: an HTTP response status is rate-limited and the calculated RetryAfter duration is less than or equal to 120 seconds
criteria.action: invoke the injectable sleep function for the duration and retry the request once
criteria.contract: the injectable sleep function is invoked with the calculated duration; the transport retries the request once and succeeds

setup: a rate-limited HTTP response with Retry-After within 120 seconds and an injectable sleep recorder

criteria.condition: an HTTP response status is rate-limited and the calculated RetryAfter duration exceeds 120 seconds
criteria.action: abort the request and return an error wrapping ErrRateLimited without retrying
criteria.contract: returns an error wrapping ErrRateLimited without issuing a retry request

setup: a rate-limited HTTP response with Retry-After exceeding 120 seconds

criteria.condition: an unauthenticated request receives an HTTP 404 status
criteria.action: return an error wrapping ErrNotFound and containing guidance that the target resource may be private and require credentials
criteria.contract: returns an error satisfying IsNotFound(err) == true and containing "resource may be private"

setup: an unauthenticated client making a request that receives an HTTP 404 response
check.pseudocode:
err := handleResponse(404, authenticated=false)
assert IsNotFound(err) == true
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "resource may be private")

criteria.condition: a custom sleep function is configured on the transport
criteria.action: invoke the custom sleep function instead of time.Sleep during retry backoff

requirements.title: No-Op Client Implementation
requirements.rationale: A no-op client allows tools to operate in offline or forge-disabled environments with predictable issue defaults and failing PR safety.

criteria.condition: Authenticated is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return false
criteria.contract: Authenticated() returns false; Close() returns nil; GetRepository returns zero-value Repository and nil error

setup: an instantiated NoOpClient instance
check.pseudocode:
client := NewNoOp()
assert client.Authenticated() == false
assert client.Close() == nil
repo, err := client.GetRepository(context.Background(), Repo{Owner: "a", Name: "b"})
assert err == nil && repo == Repository{}

criteria.condition: Close is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return nil

criteria.condition: GetRepository is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return a zero-value Repository and nil

criteria.condition: any issue read method (ReadIssue, ListIssues, ListComments) is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return a zero-value result struct and nil error
criteria.contract: issue read methods return zero-value structs with nil error; issue write methods complete silently with zero values and nil error

setup: an instantiated NoOpClient instance

criteria.condition: any issue write method (CreateIssue, UpdateIssue, CloseIssue, AddComment, AddLabels, RemoveLabel, CreateLabel) is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: perform no remote operation and return zero values with nil error

criteria.condition: any pull request method (CreatePullRequest, ReadPullRequest, ReadChangedFiles, GetPRState, GetCIChecks, GetPRReviews, PostReviewComment, MergePullRequest, ClosePullRequest) is called on NoOpClient
criteria.action: return an error indicating that pull request operations require an active forge client
criteria.contract: non-nil error containing "pull request operations require an active forge client"

setup: an instantiated NoOpClient instance
check.pseudocode:
ctx := context.Background()
client := NewNoOp()
ref := IssueRef{Repo: Repo{Owner: "a", Name: "b"}, Number: 1, IsPullRequest: true}

_, err1 := client.CreatePullRequest(ctx, ref.Repo, CreatePullRequestRequest{})
assert err1 != nil && strings.Contains(err1.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err2 := client.ReadPullRequest(ctx, ref)
assert err2 != nil && strings.Contains(err2.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err3 := client.ReadChangedFiles(ctx, ref)
assert err3 != nil && strings.Contains(err3.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err4 := client.GetPRState(ctx, ref)
assert err4 != nil && strings.Contains(err4.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err5 := client.GetCIChecks(ctx, ref)
assert err5 != nil && strings.Contains(err5.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err6 := client.GetPRReviews(ctx, ref)
assert err6 != nil && strings.Contains(err6.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

err7 := client.PostReviewComment(ctx, ref, "")
assert err7 != nil && strings.Contains(err7.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err8 := client.MergePullRequest(ctx, ref, MergeOptions{})
assert err8 != nil && strings.Contains(err8.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

err9 := client.ClosePullRequest(ctx, ref)
assert err9 != nil && strings.Contains(err9.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

execution_paths.title: Rate-limit HTTP error inspection and backoff duration calculation

steps.action: receives an HTTP response with status 429 and Retry-After header
parses the response status and headers into an HTTPError struct
invokes IsRateLimited(err) and err.RetryAfter() to inspect the error
reports true for IsRateLimited and returns the backoff duration with a 1-second buffer

end_state: the transport builds an HTTPError preserving response headers
IsRateLimited reports true for the error
